question: India's population pyramid, with a wide base and narrower top, suggests what type of population structure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Expansive**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• I**ndia's population pyramid**, with a wide base and narrower top, suggests an expansive population structure
 
• A **population pyramid with a wide base and narrow top is called an expansive pyramid, and it indicates a growing population.**
 
• This is **because a large percentage of the population is in the younger age groups, which is a sign of high birth rates.**
 
• The **narrow top indicates high death rates and lower life expectancies. **
 
• **Expansive pyramids **are common in developing countries.
 
• India is an example of a country with an expansive population pyramid. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other types of population pyramids include**:

 
 
• **Constrictive:** A pyramid with a narrow base indicates declining birth rates.
 
• **Stationary: **A pyramid with a somewhat equal proportion of the population in each age group.
